elements.requirement: Regulations made by the Secretary of State under any provision of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 may make different provision in relation to different controlled drugs, different classes of persons, different provisions of the Act, or other different cases or circumstances.
elements.quote: may make different provision in relation to different controlled drugs, different classes of persons, different provisions of this Act or other different cases or circumstances

elements.requirement: Regulations made by the Secretary of State under any provision of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 may make the opinion, consent, or approval of a prescribed authority or of any person authorised in a prescribed manner material for purposes of any provision of the regulations.
elements.quote: may make the opinion, consent or approval of a prescribed authority or of any person authorised in a prescribed manner material for purposes of any provision of the regulations

elements.requirement: Regulations made by the Secretary of State under any provision of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 may contain such supplementary, incidental, and transitional provisions as appear expedient to the Secretary of State.
elements.quote: may contain such supplementary, incidental and transitional provisions as appear expedient to the Secretary of State

elements.requirement: Any power of the Secretary of State to make regulations under the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 must be exercisable by statutory instrument.
elements.quote: Any power of the Secretary of State to make regulations under this Act shall be exercisable by statutory instrument

elements.requirement: A statutory instrument containing regulations made by the Secretary of State under the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 is subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament.
elements.quote: subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State must not make any regulations under the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 except after consultation with the Advisory Council.
elements.quote: The Secretary of State shall not make any regulations under this Act except after consultation with the Advisory Council

elements.requirement: In the application of section 31 of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 to Northern Ireland, references to the Secretary of State have effect as if references to the Ministry of Home Affairs for Northern Ireland were substituted.
elements.quote: for references to the Secretary of State there were substituted references to the Ministry of Home Affairs for Northern Ireland

elements.requirement: In the application of section 31 of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 to Northern Ireland, any regulations made under the Act by the Ministry of Home Affairs for Northern Ireland are subject to negative resolution within the meaning of section 41(6) of the Interpretation Act (Northern Ireland) 1954 as if they were a statutory instrument within the meaning of that Act.
elements.quote: Any regulations made under this Act by the Ministry of Home Affairs for Northern Ireland shall be subject to negative resolution within the meaning of section 41(6) of the Interpretation Act (Northern Ireland) 1954 as if they were a statutory instrument within the meaning of that Act

thresholds.what: the calendar year of the Interpretation Act (Northern Ireland) governing negative resolution procedure
